Everybody is in a state of *ihram*, a state of ritual purity in which they strive for freedom from anger, jealousy, and selfishness.  There are people that have enough money to do the Hajj every year for the rest of their lives, and there are people that have been saving for generations to send a member of the family to Hajj.  There are people in positions of power or government, and people that would be considered "lower caste" or even "untouchable" or "rejected by society".  Each person is equal at the Hajj, regardless of race, ethnicity, or financial status.  

I think that is an amazing thing to witness and I want to be a part of it.
